elements.label: App page body: Version admin content (with nav drawer) clears to a blank white loading page

elements.manual_reason: No candidate box covers the loading spinner that appears at the page centre.
elements.label: Circular loading spinner
Mouse cursor after clicking the P&L menu entry

pattern.description: After the P&L entry is clicked, the page body cuts to blank white, the breadcrumb updates to 'Sheets / P&L' and a spinner appears while the sheet loads.
pattern.why_premium: Not premium as recorded: an unedited loading state left in the demo. The breadcrumb update does confirm the navigation; a polished cut would trim the wait or replace it with a skeleton or crossfade.

build_hint.gsap: Better to skip the loading state: tl.to(oldPage, {opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.in'}).set(breadcrumb, {textContent: 'Sheets / P&L'}).fromTo(newSheet, {opacity: 0, y: 8}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}); if the spinner is kept, gsap.to(spinner, {rotation: 360, repeat: -1, duration: 0.8, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: Crossfade old page to new sheet: opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [1, 0]) for the old page and interpolate(frame, [6, 16], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}) for the new; spinner rotate = (frame / fps) * 450 deg if shown.

notes: Diff boxes b02-b04 sit on blank white areas (residue of the cleared page) and are not listed separately. The cursor moves only slightly; its direction is uncertain.
